decisions.reason: As a recently launched and still publicly promoted system, it benefits from sunk development and marketing investments and management can plausibly attribute any weaker uptake to a normal industrial ramp-up period.

The centrifuge remains on the website after its first year, suggesting visible commitment and enough strategic fit with the firm's coolant-handling offering to justify continued support rather than an early withdrawal.

A scraper belt chip conveyor is close to the firm's core machinery-equipment business, so a large German manufacturer is likely to persist with it given portfolio fit, installed-base logic, and the desire to justify prior investment.

Because the hinged belt chip conveyor is still actively marketed and appears central to a broader conveying portfolio, management is likely to continue it and interpret any shortfall as temporary rather than abandon it quickly.
